provenance.observed: Frozen E1 solver outputs and E2 weak-response validator judgments.
provenance.reconstructed: Cascade routes; strong calls are reused E1 observations, not new escalations.
provenance.hypothetical: q_i probabilities, their overlap/placement, and D/C/F human expectations.
provenance.cost: Frozen E1 normalized input and output+thought USD list-price estimates; not invoices.

assumptions.human_parameters: hypothetical D,C,F; unchanged per case and queue

limitations: Billing SGD totals are external corroboration only; not assigned to individual historical calls.
E1 strong outputs reused counterfactually; live cascades and human decisions were NOT executed.
810 slots per validator role repeat 270 frozen solver realizations; only 30 canonical cases.
Costs are estimated from normalized tokens using frozen USD rates, not actual invoices.
No human measurements, asymmetric losses, delays, human approval authority or deployment validity.
Frozen raw SHA checks require trusted Audit 03; scorer and policy dependencies are not cryptographically bound.
Routing acts only on saved PASS/FAIL verdict, not oracle truth.
Existing stronger preflight remains an independent prerequisite.

equations.q_semantics: Marginal hypothetical probability, not a generated or observed wrong answer.
equations.joint_semantics: Same source q under both validator roles and every attached repetition; no independence assumption needed for expectations.
equations.placement_bounds: Greedy fractional allocation by FAIL exposure; whole-case grouping enforces equal q within a canonical case.
equations.geometry: Uniform and concentration paths: exact affine partition including tolerance offsets. Overlap: exact lower-envelope polygons and active equality segments; grid ranks use unchanged tolerance.

limitations: No empirical strong failures; q and strong/weak/routing overlap are unidentified.
Fixed recorded costs do not estimate tokens for genuinely different strong outputs.
Validator judgments are on frozen weak answers and are not perturbed.
30 selected synthetic canonical cases; no independent-270 or independent-810 inference.
Whole-case continuous paths use fractional marginal probabilities; binary whole-case samples separately identified.
Placement extremes are optimized per target role, not simultaneously optimal for both roles.
No new asymmetric loss, delay, human competence measurements or operational validity.
